sql: select p.market_ticker, p.period_reward_usd pool, p.start_date, p.end_date, count(o.*) n_orders, min(o.created_at) first_bid, max(o.created_at) last_bid, string_agg(distinct o.side||o.limit_price||'x'||o.quantity::int, ',') bids from incentive_programs p join live_orders o on o.market_ticker=p.market_ticker and o.strategy='Alimm1' and o.action='buy' and o.created_at between p.start_date and p.end_date where p.incentive_type='liquidity' and p.end_date between '2026-10-03' and '2026-10-07 02:00' group by 1,2,3,4 order by p.end_date
